nodes.label: Edit patch v2

Grafted: direct writes lock and re-check, legacy payloads refused, base-less phone drafts dropped, GPS companions carry no base, BranchForScore.equipmentConfirmed required, typed value kept with Use this value, Approve disabled on stale rows, chunked locked rescore, gate frozen with the branch set.

nodes.label: F06: touched-only patch with loaded bases (stale-form overwrite fix)
nodes.rationale: The client sends only fields that differ from what it loaded, each with its base; the server plans each against live: CONVERGED skipped, STALE refused with STALE_FIELDS before any write, otherwise CHANGE. Applies to salesmen, drafts and direct writes.

nodes.label: F20: omitted = keep, null = clear, value = set

nodes.label: F16: channel / sub-channel pair validation at submit, approval and import

nodes.label: F19: phone fold and normalise before validate (Persian digits accepted)
